title: Cross-Dataset Meta-Analysis of RAMA Experiments: Effect Sizes, Consistency Audit, and Framing Recommendation
summary: Demo notebook performing a 6-phase cross-dataset meta-analysis of 5 RAMA experiments. Recomputes Phase A (per-task Cohen's d with 10K bootstrap CIs for 5 tasks) and Phase B (DerSimonian-Laird random-effects pooling), then displays pre-computed Phases C-E (consistency audit, degeneracy diagnosis, rank conditioning). Ends with a summary table and forest plot visualization. Uses 50 examples across 5 tasks (rel-f1, rel-stack, rel-amazon). Full original N_BOOTSTRAP=10000 runs in ~113s.
